citations.assessment: The parallel says Others report permission to eat and then distinguishes dining tables and other tables. The longer witness has material omitted in the root.
The checked Bavli reads be-apikoran and explains no washing of hands or rinsing of the mouth. Agra is the father-in-law of Rabbi Abba.
Ran explicitly ties the cloth gloss to the Rif reading be-apkolis and gives a separate explanation for be-apikoran in other copies.
